items.title: Two Ways to Play
items.body: Find the Battle Royale experience that fits! Standard Battle Royale lets players collect resources and build walls, ramps, and structures on the fly. Zero Build removes building, so players can focus on combat and movement. Zero Build is a great place to start!

items.title: Land Smart to Start Strong
items.body: At the start of each match, drop from the Battle Bus and aim for a less crowded area. This gives time to loot and gear up before the fight begins… unless you want to kick things off with a bang!

items.title: Play Defense with Health and Shields
items.body: Keeping track of Shields and Health is critical to survival. Grab and consume Shield Potions as soon as possible, as low Shields means going down faster in a fight. Use healing items like Med Kits to recover Health between encounters, preferably before the next battle begins!

items.title: Open Chests for the Best Loot
items.body: Valuable Chests are scattered across the Island and contain healing items, weapons, and more, with different rarities of Chests providing different qualities of loot. Listen for the shimmering audio cue to track them down!

items.title: Horrors Worth Facing Together
items.body: Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares! Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist. Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.
